description: This file defines the interface for media pipeline capabilities in the Rialto project, including factory creation and querying supported MIME types and support status for specific MIME types.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IMediaPipelineCapabilities instances.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineCapabilities
classes.description: Interface for querying media pipeline capabilities, such as supported MIME types.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IMediaPipelineCapabilities instance.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of MIME types supported for a given source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
